artworks.title: The Course
artworks.description: The image shows a group of elegantly dressed individuals on horses. There are cumulus clouds in the sky and more horses and riders in the distance. The brushwork shows fine detailing of the clothing and horses, with a gentle color palette of soft blues and creams in the sky, and earthy tones in the attire and horses.

artworks.title: The Overdrove Ox
artworks.description: This is a painting of a chaotic street scene involving an overdriven ox. The scene depicts an ox causing havoc amongst a crowd and several horses, with a backdrop that includes a church tower and a vista of ships in a harbor. People are shown in various states of distress and activity as the ox runs amok. The composition is dynamic with numerous details portraying the bustling confusion of the event, including a cart labelled "Crockford London Atheneum AMA".

artworks.title: The Enamoured Sportsman
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a man and a woman, with both their upper bodies in view and extending to their knees. The woman is seated at the base of a tree, facing slightly to her left, dressed in a pale blue gown with long sleeves and an ornate white lace collar. Her hair is blonde, long, and curly, with a bonnet tied with a pink ribbon. The man is kneeling beside her right side, wearing a coral pink coat with brass buttons and a white cravat, and his hair is light-colored with gentle curls. He looks up towards the woman, holding her hands. Gold bands are visible on each of her wrists. Behind them stands a horse with a brown coat, along with the wheel of a carriage and a tree trunk. The scene is framed by lush green foliage with a landscape visible in the distance under a blue sky.

artworks.title: First and Second Floor
artworks.description: The image shows illustrations of four women positioned at two different windows. Two women lean out of a window with an open pane, one resting both arms on the window sill wearing a wide-brimmed hat with large pink flowers, and the other with curly hair, wearing a cap and leaning with one arm on the sill and the other hand on her hip. The other two women are seen at another window, dressed in elaborate 18th-century clothing with lace and ruffles. One wears a green feathered headpiece and the other wears a blue feathered piece in her hair. A stone or brick wall serves as the backdrop, with the lower window having a sash frame and being partially draped with curtains. Text beneath the image labels it as "First & Second Floor".

artworks.title: The Prospect before us, No. 2
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance in a grand theater. The drawing features a scene set in an elaborate theater with a highly detailed audience filling the multi-tiered balconies. Two central figures are depicted on stage, energetically dancing and holding garlands of flowers. The theater is grand, with intricately designed boxes and a chandelier on the sides. The audience is animated, each person expressing different emotions as they watch the performance. The overall tone of the drawing is vibrant and lively.

artworks.title: A Little Tighter
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a dynamic pose. One person is wearing a white dress with a pink bodice and has curly hair with a large feather. The other person is in motion, wearing a blue coat and yellow stockings. Both have round faces with distinct facial features. The smaller person is leaning backward, reaching upward. A tricorn hat lies on the floor. The background is plain and light gray to highlight the figures.

artworks.title: Slugs in a Sawpit
artworks.description: This is a painting of two men facing each other in a saw-pit, engaged in a confrontation through a telescope-like device. The figure on the left wears a blue coat with gold trimming and a tricorne hat, while the figure on the right is in a red coat with a black hat. They appear to be scrutinizing each other through the shared object. The setting is a saw-pit with wood shavings, saws, and a ladder leading out. The expressions and postures of the figures convey a sense of absurdity and satire. In the background, a third figure peers over the edge of the pit. The painting features expressive lines and subtle coloring, typical of satirical work from the late 18th century. This follows the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Mr. H. Angelo's Fencing Academy
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene in a fencing academy. The image shows a lively interior of a fencing school where several figures are engaged in and observing a swordfight. The room is filled with fencing-related items, such as masks and foils, and portraits decorating the walls. The composition captures the energy and movement of the duelists while emphasizing the elaborate attire of the spectators. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his humorous and satirical depictions of social scenes.

artworks.title: A Squall in Hyde Park
artworks.description: This is a painting of a street scene with a carriage and pedestrians in a bustling setting. The scene conveys a sense of chaos with people and animals reacting to something happening in the street. Some people appear disarrayed, with hats and umbrellas flying in the air. The background shows residential buildings with blue roofs and trees. The style resembles that of Thomas Rowlandson, known for caricatures and social commentary through humorous depictions.

artworks.title: Beauties
artworks.description: The image portrays two women shown from the waist up, each seated and facing slightly towards each other. The woman on the left has a round face with soft features, wearing an elaborate blue bonnet with curly blonde hair visible beneath it. Her dress is pink with a high ruffled collar and cuffs, and she holds a small fan in her right hand. She sits on a chair with a blue cushion, wearing a gold bracelet. The woman on the right has similar facial features and curly hair, in a wide-brimmed bonnet in multicolored shades of yellow and pink, tied with a blue ribbon. Her dress is light blue with floral accents, featuring ruffled collar and cuffs. She sits with her hands resting in her lap. The background is plain and off-white with no discernible details, framed by a simple grey border.

artworks.title: La Table d'Hote
artworks.description: The image contains various shapes and lines, including elongated ovals and vertical stripes. A group of people are seated around a long table. The scene includes pointed noses and exaggerated features, resembling caricatures of dining gentlemen. In the background, there is a wall with a framed image labeled "VERSAILLES" and a clock showing the time.

artworks.title: Botheration
artworks.description: The image shows five men in an office setting, dressed in 18th-century attire. They are gathered around a table covered with documents, engaged in discussions. There are papers and books scattered on the floor, with notices on the walls. The room is decorated with a sign labeled "Court of King's Bench & Common Pleas". The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Drown'd
artworks.description: Several people are shown on a sandy beach. One person is lying on their back in a blue jacket, red trousers, and a white shirt. Three other figures are crouched or kneeling on the sand. One person has light-colored curly hair and wears a yellow dress, another has short orange hair and wears a brown outfit, and the third person has curly hair tied back, wearing a blue top and white undergarments. Behind them, a figure in a pink dress is partially obscured. A wooden boat and a large dark rock formation are seen on the sand. In the background, the sea with small waves and a light blue sky complete the coastal scene.

artworks.title: Miseries of London
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a busy street scene. The image shows a mix of carriages, pedestrians, and various activities, conveying a sense of chaos and action. A yellow carriage is stuck in a traffic jam caused by other coaches, with horses rearing. People are seen engaged in different activities such as sitting on carriages, climbing scaffolding, or spilling from buildings. A group of individuals is struggling with a cart on the left side. There is a diverse range of expressions among the characters, from surprise to frustration. The background displays city architecture, including a prominent spire among building rooftops. The scene is humorous and exaggerated, depicting the challenges of navigating through the energetic and often chaotic city life.

artworks.title: Royal Cock Pit
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cockfight arena. The oval room is filled with a crowd leaning over railings to watch a cockfight. The room is lit by tall windows. In the center, two roosters are fighting. The walls have decorative elements, including a central emblem or coat of arms. The drawing depicts the atmosphere of an entertainment venue.

artworks.title: The Corsican Spider in his Web
artworks.artist: Thomas Rowlandson, after George Moutard Woodward
artworks.medium: etching with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate web with a spider and various flies. The drawing describes a large spider at the center of a web. Around the spider, numerous flies are entangled in the web, each representing different historical or political connotations such as "British Fly," "Spanish Fly," "Russian Fly," among others. Each fly has its own label. The web is intricately drawn, capturing a sense of entrapment and hierarchy. The background is colored in a light blue shade with some dark shading on the upper part of the drawing. The title at the bottom reads "The Corsican Spider in His Web."

artworks.title: Doctor Gallipot placing his Fortune at the feet of his Mistress
artworks.description: The image displays two main figures, a man and a woman. The man is kneeling on one knee, looking up at the woman. He has a powdered white wig, a prominent nose, and a ruddy complexion. He is dressed in a blue coat, yellow waistcoat, and red breeches, holding a scroll. The woman stands with one arm extended, wearing a headscarf and a long, flowing dress. Objects on the floor include a bottle labeled "Life Drops," a book, and a cloth. In the background, a dark curtain partially reveals a doorway with an older man peeking in.

artworks.title: Butterfly Hunting
artworks.description: The image shows a well-maintained garden pathway with a small group of people chasing butterflies with nets. In the background, there is a distant church-like building surrounded by trees. The style features detailed brushstrokes defining the figures, architecture, and plants. The color palette includes vibrant greens, yellows, blues, and soft pastels. Close to us, a man runs after a butterfly near a flowerbed, while two other figures join in the pursuit. On the right, two women stand near a house door, with a third figure watching from an open window above them.

artworks.title: The Hunt
artworks.description: The image depicts a hunting scene with riders on horseback. The scene shows several horseback riders chasing what appear to be foxes or hounds through a countryside. The landscape includes trees on the left, a fallen tree, and a road or path where the riders are galloping. The sky is painted in soft hues of orange and pink. The image conveys a sense of motion and energy, capturing the excitement of the chase. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Sports of a Country Fair
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene at a country fair. The image shows a group of people in a commotion, with figures falling from a building onto a crowd below. A theater-style setting with a stairway is visible, and some figures are jumping down onto others. The building has a sign that reads "Cockburn's Company." A banner in the background indicates additional entertainment. The illustration uses bright colors and exaggerated expressions to emphasize the chaotic and humorous nature of the event. The style is reminiscent of George Cruikshank.

artworks.title: The Boxes
artworks.description: This is a drawing showcasing multiple levels of theater boxes filled with animated spectators. The expressions of the onlookers vary. Each row of boxes is adorned with decorative elements. The topmost row features exaggerated expressions, while the crowd appears active in the lower levels. The illustration includes theatre curtains, ornate decorations, and paraphernalia, creating a lively atmosphere. The scene captures a dynamic moment of engagement and excitement at the theater in a humorous manner.

artworks.title: Insurable Cattle
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of animals and individuals gathered in front of a building with a sign. The scene depicts various animals including a white horse, several cows, sheep, and a dog in the foreground. The creatures face a line of men standing near the entrance to a building, where a sign reads "Dicky Gossip Cow Doctor and Agent to the Cattle Life Insurance Company Instituted 1809 Capital £500,000.” The men appear to be engaged in a discussion, observing the animals, with one of the individuals holding a document. The setting is whimsical, reminiscent of satirical illustrations from the early 19th century.

artworks.title: Cattle Not Insurable
artworks.description: This is a painting of a small boat filled with people in front of a large ship. The image depicts a lively scene where a small boat crowded with individuals is positioned adjacent to a large ship. The figures in the small boat are dressed in vibrant clothing, with the colorful fabrics of pink, blue, yellow, and white, contributing to the festive atmosphere. The boaters appear to be waving towards the large ship, and one holds up a glass as if in a toast. In the background, the large ship is detailed with figures along its deck, mast, and riggings, suggesting busy activity or preparation.

artworks.title: Dying for Love, or Captain Careless shot flying by a Girl of Fifteen, who Unexpectedly Popped her Head out of a Casement
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a village scene. The artwork shows a moment outside a small house with a thatched roof and ivy-clad walls. A woman leans out of a window, interacting with a soldier in a red coat. Below the window, a group of women stand near a water pump. An older woman leans over a gate, observing. A dog barks nearby, and another figure stands to the right. The drawing is detailed, with colorful architecture, foliage, and human expressions. It is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
